WITH trans_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    transref, 
    AVG(anlycount) as avg_anlycount
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE anlycount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY transref
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) as overall_average
  FROM trans_avgs
),
kept_transactions AS (
  SELECT 
    ta.transref,
    ta.avg_anlycount
  FROM trans_avgs ta
  WHERE ta.avg_anlycount > (SELECT overall_average FROM overall_avg)
),
kept_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) as kept_average
  FROM kept_transactions
)
SELECT 
  kt.transref,
  kt.avg_anlycount,
  kt.avg_anlycount - (SELECT overall_average FROM overall_avg) as diff_from_overall,
  kt.avg_anlycount - (SELECT kept_average FROM kept_avg) as diff_from_kept
FROM kept_transactions kt
ORDER BY 
  diff_from_kept DESC,
  kt.transref
LIMIT 10
